shortDescription.default: Enterprise CRM inside SharePoint & Teams: leads, accounts, deals, quotes, demos, cases, forecasting.

longDescription.default: Brillienta CRM is a complete CRM that runs inside Microsoft 365 and stores all data in your own SharePoint site. Sales: leads with scoring and round-robin assignment, accounts, contacts, opportunities with a drag-and-drop pipeline, products and branded quotes. Marketing: demo requests with Teams meeting scheduling, campaigns with ROI. Service: cases with SLA tracking. Insights: dashboards, forecasting with quotas, reports and a calendar. Integrations: Outlook email, Teams meetings and channel notifications, Microsoft AppSource / Partner Center leads, Power Automate and webhooks, CSV import/export. Enterprise: role-based security, audit log, custom fields.
